findings.title: Pin-order epoch-0 timestamp falls back to recency
findings.problem: sortPinnedByPinOrder computes `getValidDateTimestamp(pinOrder[a.id]) || getValidDateTimestamp(a.updateDate, a.date)`. If pinOrder[a.id] is a valid ISO string that parses to exactly epoch 0 (1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z), the left side is the falsy value 0, so the `||` silently falls through to the updateDate/date fallback instead of using the recorded pin order.
findings.impact: A pinned chat whose recorded pin-order timestamp is exactly epoch 0 (e.g. malformed/legacy backend date data reaching ensurePinOrder's fallbackIso in src/store/chats.ts:326) sorts by recency again, reproducing the exact defect this ticket fixes for that one chat. This comparator is shared by both the Focused and Unified views (chatSidebarCollectionHelpers.ts, imported by both view models), so the mis-sort is not confined to one view.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish 'no recorded pin order' from 'recorded as 0ms' explicitly instead of relying on truthiness, e.g. check `pinOrder[a.id] !== undefined` before falling back to updateDate/date.

findings.title: Pinned-flag fix lacks merge round-trip test
findings.problem: The added 'does not clobber an existing pinned chat list item' test asserts only that _updateChatMetadata's bare return value has no `pinned` key (line 258: `expect(update).not.toHaveProperty('pinned')`). It never seeds an existing pinned:true ChatListItem in mockChatsStore.chats nor asserts the post-merge `pinned` value through chatsStore.updateChatListItem, as the spec's Testing section explicitly requested.
findings.impact: The behavior actually being fixed — updateChatListItem's definedUpdates merge clobbering an existing pinned:true with a stray pinned:false from _updateChatMetadata's return — is confirmed correct only by reading chatGeneration.ts and chats.ts directly, not by the test suite. A future change that reintroduces a `pinned` key on that code path would not be caught by this test.
findings.recommendation: Extend or add a test that seeds mockChatsStore.chats with a pinned:true ChatListItem, runs the resulting update object through chatsStore.updateChatListItem, and asserts the stored item's `pinned` flag is still true afterward.
